assertions.title: OpenAI and Azure chat-bar toggles honor native-vs-local routing policy

steps.action: Open OpenAI chat on dev rail, open Tools Options, pin Search/Code Interpreter/File Search, and enable toggles
steps.expected: Toggles can be enabled from chat bar/tools without forced settings dialog
steps.observed: All three toggles were pinned and enabled directly in chat UI without modal redirect.

steps.action: Send OpenAI message with all three toggles enabled
steps.expected: Provider-native routing path should execute according to policy
steps.observed: Message completed successfully with toggles active; conversation metadata shows endpoint=openAI, model=gpt-5.4.

steps.action: Attempt Azure path in model picker and send Azure-scoped message
steps.expected: Azure-native routing behavior can be exercised
steps.observed: Azure option appeared but execution remained on openAI endpoint in resulting conversations; Azure user key/base URL remained unset (user_provided + key expiresAt null).

evidence.network: OpenAI turn body and conversation metadata: r3-provider001-openai-body-after-send.txt, r3-provider001-conversation.json, r3-provider001-azure-conversation.json; Azure/user key state: r3-provider-env-snapshot.json + r3-api-keys-azureOpenAI.json

assertions.issues: Azure credential-dependent execution branch remained blocked: AZURE_API_KEY and AZURE_OPENAI_BASEURL are configured as user_provided and user key status remained expiresAt=null, so Azure-native runtime behavior could not be conclusively exercised.

assertions.title: Azure direct /openai/v1 routes omit api-version

steps.action: Set temporary superadmin azureOpenAI user key payload with direct /openai/v1 baseURL and fallback deployment list
steps.expected: Direct route should use /openai/v1/models and preserve per-user fallback models
steps.observed: Payload saved and reopened successfully; superadmin saw fallback azureOpenAI models while val-user remained empty (no cache poisoning).

steps.action: Inspect dev API logs for outbound Azure model fetch URL
steps.expected: Direct URL should omit api-version query parameter
steps.observed: Logs show GET https://nonexistent-subdomain-r3b-...openai.azure.com/openai/v1/models (no api-version query string).

steps.action: Open Azure settings dialog after save
steps.expected: Saved API key/baseURL/models should preload for same user
steps.observed: Dialog preloaded apiKey/baseURL/models exactly as saved, then temporary key was cleaned up.

evidence.network: API mutation + model snapshots: r3-provider001A-api.json, r3-provider001A-models-superadmin-after-set.json, r3-provider001A-models-user-after-set.json; direct URL log: r3-provider001A-azure-direct-url-log.txt; preload values: r3-provider001A-azure-settings-values.json; cleanup check: r3-provider001A-post-cleanup-keycheck.json

assertions.issues: Legacy non-/openai/v1 Azure branch (expected api-version-on-legacy verification) was not executed in this run; direct-route behavior and per-user isolation were validated.

assertions.title: OpenAI and Azure Responses history reconstruction replays only safe reasoning context

steps.action: Create new OpenAI conversation with Search enabled and run turn 1 requiring web-search output
steps.observed: Turn 1 completed with web-search-attempt output and source URL text.

steps.action: Send two follow-up turns referencing prior tool output
steps.observed: Both follow-ups completed successfully with coherent context carryover and no invalid-history/runtime reconstruction errors surfaced.

steps.action: Check conversation metadata after multi-turn flow
steps.expected: Conversation remains healthy and appendable after tool-output turns
steps.observed: Conversation persisted as openAI/gpt-5.4 with completed message sequence and no replay-breakage symptoms.

evidence.network: Turn transcripts and convo metadata: r3-provider001B-turn1-body.txt, r3-provider001B-turn2-body.txt, r3-provider001B-turn3-body.txt, r3-provider001B-conversation.json

assertions.title: Native OpenAI file flows stay tracked locally without duplicate file processing

steps.action: Enable File Search and attempt official 'Upload for File Search' attach-menu automation
steps.expected: File upload path should be selectable and processable
steps.observed: Menuitem upload control is not an HTML input for direct setInputFiles; agent-browser upload on menuitem failed.

steps.action: Apply DOM-level file-input workaround and upload test file, then query file in chat
steps.expected: Uploaded file should be available to model and tracked in conversation/file metadata
steps.observed: File chip appeared in composer but model replied that uploaded file content was unavailable; conversation metadata files array remained empty.

steps.action: Attempt direct /api/files metadata read for confirmation
steps.expected: File metadata endpoint confirms tracked uploaded file without ban side effects
steps.observed: /api/files probe returned temporary-ban response in this run, forcing reseed/restart before continuing other assertions.

evidence.network: Automation failure note: r3-provider002-upload-menuitem-error.txt; model response: r3-provider002-chat-body.txt; conversation metadata: r3-provider002-conversation.json; files API ban evidence: r3-provider002-api-files-headers.txt + r3-provider002-api-files-response.txt

assertions.issues: Could not conclusively validate native OpenAI file-tracking/no-duplicate contract because official Upload-for-File-Search UI path was not reliably automatable and metadata verification attempts triggered anti-abuse ban responses in this run.

assertions.title: Gemini native tools honor safe-request and routing gates

steps.action: Select google endpoint and gemini-2.5-pro model, run safe request with Search enabled and no attached file
steps.expected: Safe request should execute and expose native/fallback behavior
steps.observed: Request failed with GoogleGenerativeAI 400 API_KEY_INVALID (API Key not found).

steps.action: Attach file and run unsafe mixed request (search + attached file)
steps.expected: Unsafe mix should force fallback behavior rather than unsafe native payload
steps.observed: Request again failed at provider auth stage with the same API_KEY_INVALID error before routing-gate behavior could be observed.

evidence.network: Safe/unsafe turn bodies: r3-provider003-google-safe-turn-body.txt, r3-provider003-google-unsafe-file-body.txt; google conversation metadata: r3-provider003-google-conversation.json; API log errors: r3-provider-google-api-log-tail.txt

assertions.issues: Blocked by invalid Google runtime credential path (API_KEY_INVALID), so safe-request and mixed-payload routing gates could not be conclusively validated.

assertions.title: Google live discovery and capability metadata stay intact

steps.action: Verify config/runtime preconditions for live discovery
steps.expected: With GOOGLE_MODELS unset and valid credentials, live discovery should provide usable model/capability metadata
steps.observed: GOOGLE_MODELS is unset and UI shows Google model list, but dev API logs repeatedly report failed Gemini model discovery (status 400).

steps.action: Attempt real google model execution to confirm discovered models are runnable
steps.expected: Discovered model should execute if live credentials are valid
steps.observed: gemini-2.5-pro execution fails with API_KEY_INVALID, so live discovery/capability correctness cannot be validated end-to-end.

evidence.network: Config/model snapshots: r3-api-models-superadmin-postreseed.json, r3-api-config-superadmin-postreseed.json, r3-provider004-google-discovery-summary.json; repeated discovery/runtime failures: r3-provider-google-api-log-tail.txt

assertions.issues: Blocked by invalid Google key path: model discovery/fetch and execution both return 400/API_KEY_INVALID, preventing live-discovery capability validation.

assertions.title: Gemini grounding still produces inline citations and Sources entries

steps.action: Run grounded Google request in gemini-2.5-pro chat with Search enabled
steps.expected: Grounded response should render inline citations and Sources entries
steps.observed: Request failed before response generation with GoogleGenerativeAI API_KEY_INVALID error.

steps.action: Retry with attached-file mixed request after google model selection
steps.expected: Grounded/citation rendering should still be inspectable
steps.observed: Second attempt failed with same API_KEY_INVALID error; no grounded response/citation rendering was produced.

evidence.network: Failure payloads in r3-provider003-google-safe-turn-body.txt and r3-provider003-google-unsafe-file-body.txt; corresponding provider/runtime logs in r3-provider-google-api-log-tail.txt

assertions.issues: Blocked by Google API_KEY_INVALID errors, so grounded Gemini citation rendering could not be exercised in this environment run.

frictions.description: Attach-menu item 'Upload for File Search' is not an HTML input element for direct agent-browser upload.
frictions.resolution: Used DOM exposure of hidden input[type=file] as workaround to continue upload attempts; captured failure and workaround evidence.

frictions.description: Direct authenticated /api/files verification call triggered temporary-ban response mid-run.
frictions.resolution: Ran required anti-abuse reset (dev-seed-validation-personas.js + docker restart librechat-dev-api + wait) and resumed tests.

frictions.description: Provider switch attempts can appear to remain on OpenAI unless both endpoint and concrete model are explicitly selected.
frictions.resolution: Retried with explicit Google endpoint + gemini-2.5-pro model selection; verified endpoint=google via conversation metadata.

blockers.description: Azure runtime branch remains credential-gated in this dev environment (user-provided Azure key/base URL not configured for executable Azure turn coverage).
blockers.quickFixAttempted: Injected temporary per-user azureOpenAI test payload to validate direct /openai/v1 behavior and settings preload; legacy non-/openai/v1 execution branch still not exercised.

blockers.description: Google credential path is invalid at runtime: Gemini requests return API_KEY_INVALID and model fetch logs repeatedly fail with status 400.
blockers.quickFixAttempted: Explicitly selected google endpoint + gemini-2.5-pro and retried safe and file-attached requests; both failed with API Key not found / API_KEY_INVALID.

blockers.description: Native OpenAI file tracking/no-duplicate contract could not be conclusively verified through official upload path plus metadata inspection in this run.
blockers.quickFixAttempted: Attempted official attach-menu upload, then hidden-input workaround, then conversation/file metadata checks; conversation files remained empty and /api/files probe triggered temporary-ban.

summary: Tested 7 assigned assertions: 1 passed (VAL-PROVIDER-001B) and 6 blocked (VAL-PROVIDER-001, 001A, 002, 003, 004, 005). Explicit multi-turn Responses reconstruction attempt for VAL-PROVIDER-001B succeeded across three turns after web-search tool output with no invalid-history errors.
